title: Shipping & Cargo Loading
short_description: Learn how logistics systems select, organize, and load packages efficiently while respecting vehicle capacity and maximizing cargo value.
real_world_context: A logistics company needs to decide which packages should be loaded into a vehicle while respecting weight and capacity limitations and maximizing value.
learning_objectives: Understand how package weights and values can be represented using arrays.
Apply 0/1 Knapsack to select complete packages while maximizing cargo value within a capacity limit.
Use sorting to organize packages by weight for systematic cargo loading.
Apply Fractional Knapsack and Greedy strategies when cargo materials can be divided.
Use a Greedy approach to maximize the number of packages loaded into a capacity-limited vehicle.
Apply Binary Search on Answer to determine the minimum vehicle capacity required for a fixed number of trips.
Choose an appropriate optimization strategy based on whether packages are indivisible, divisible, or must be shipped in a fixed order.

real_world_mapping.package_weights: Weights of packages to be loaded or shipped
real_world_mapping.package_values: Value or priority associated with packages
real_world_mapping.vehicle_capacity: Maximum weight the vehicle can carry
real_world_mapping.cargo_materials: Divisible materials that can be loaded in partial quantities
real_world_mapping.package_order: Fixed order in which packages must be shipped
real_world_mapping.cargo_loading: Selecting and arranging packages within vehicle capacity

completion_message: Great job! You have completed the Shipping & Cargo Loading scenario and practiced knapsack, sorting, greedy, and binary search on answer techniques used in logistics and cargo planning.
